# QR code generator

QRCode for JavaScript by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT), as adapted for Node in
[qrcode-terminal](https://github.com/gtanner/qrcode-terminal) 0.11.0. Copied unchanged.

Used only by the PC companion (`companion/sync.mjs`) to draw the pairing QR code as SVG.
